posts.snippet: Hi All, 📢 We’re Hiring: Senior Power BI Analyst – Dubai (Onsite) Accely is looking for an experienced Senior Power BI Analyst for a Dubai onsite engagement, supporting the Dubai time zone ...
posts.author: Abhijeet Bhalerao
posts.content:
Hi All, 
   
📢 We’re Hiring: Senior Power BI Analyst – Dubai (Onsite)

Accely is looking for an experienced Senior Power BI Analyst for a Dubai onsite engagement, supporting the Dubai time zone.
 
 🔹 Role: Power BI Analyst
 🔹 Work Mode: Dubai – Onsite
 🔹 Time Zone: Dubai, UAE
 
 Mandatory requirements
 
 We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Power BI Analyst to join our data and analytics Marketing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining interactive dashboards and reports that transform raw data into actionable insights. This role requires a blend of technical proficiency, business acumen, and user-centric design thinking.
  
Required Skills
  
Proficiency      in Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, and Power      Query
Experience      with Azure, SharePoint, and Databricks
Strong      understanding of data visualization principles and UX/UI      design
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Dashboard      & Report Development: Design and build visually compelling,      interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI Desktop and Power BI      Service
Data      Modeling: Develop and maintain robust data models using star and      snowflake schema patterns; implement calculated columns and measures using      DAX
Front-End      Optimization: Ensure optimal performance and usability of dashboards,      including layout design, drill-through actions, bookmarks, and custom      visuals.
Data      Integration: Connect and transform data from multiple sources      (Databricks, SQL Server, Excel, APIs, etc.) using Power Query and ETL      processes.
Timesheet:      Fulfilled the MBRF standard timesheet with the main activities per day, to      share this for invoice proposal.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications & knowledge
  
PowerBI      Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate or equivalent certification
Understanding      of sales and commercial performance metrics.
Familiarity      with market share and retail analytics concepts.
Strong      analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective      communication.
Exposure      to Nielsen, EPOS, or FMCG analytics is an advantage.
  
 
  
#Hiring #PowerBI #PowerBIAnalyst #PowerBIDeveloper #SeniorConsultant #DataAnalytics#Accely#Dubai
  

 📩 Interested candidates: Please share your updated CV or connect with us to discuss this opportunity.
 
 abhijeet.b@accely.com
 
 Regards, 
 Abhijeet Bhalerao
